props.caption: Intel said Fab 28 had been shut down for about two weeks and expected production to start up by the end of that week.
Four members of El Salvador’s Gang Suppression Force went missing after an 18 October ambush in Croix-des-Bouquets.
The Bank of Japan held its overnight call-rate target around 1.25% in an 8–1 vote.

lead.what: Intel’s desk assigns a 65% chance that Fab 28 constrains server-chip availability in public guidance by 31 January 2027.

rest.what: El Salvador has deployed more than 2,000 soldiers to Haiti to retrieve four nationals who went missing after an ambush.

lead.what: The Bank of Japan held its overnight call-rate target around 1.25% and will increase planned annual ETF sales from January 2027.

rest.what: The Riksdag is scheduled to test Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist’s nomination on 3 November at 13:00.

lead.what: Sir Patrick Stewart died aged 86 following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.
